title: The Diophantine Problem in Wreath Products of Groups
summary: We study the Diophantine problem in restricted wreath products of groups. Write $G=B\wr H$, where $B$ is the passive factor and $H$ is the active factor. The main results demonstrate that in a wide class of wreath products $G$, the Diophantine problem is undecidable. First, we show that if both factors are indicable, then $G$ has a retract isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}\wr\mathbb{Z}$ and therefore has undecidable Diophantine problem.
